title: La crisis de 1982
goal: Read how the US Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes under Volcker made Latin American debt suddenly unpayable, and how the August 1982 payments crisis followed.

items: Explain what the Fed did under Volcker starting in 1979.
Explain why this hit variable-rate debt so hard.
Describe how international banks stopped lending and investor confidence vanished overnight.
Explain why the August 1982 crisis was the largest payments crisis in modern Latin American history.
Use de un día para otro to stress a sudden change.
